FOUR DIFFERENT SHOWS!!Stphane Wrembel Rochester Concert SeriesSaturday, October 10 8:00 PM Dreamers of Dreams (2014)Inspired by the poem Ode by Arthur OShaughnessy, opening with its famous lines:We are the music makers, and we are the dreamers of dreamsA cosmic journey that expands the desert imagery into the universe itself a dream world among the stars. A cinematic, expansive experience with echoes of 2001: A Space Odyssey, where music becomes interstellar travel.This program also draws inspiration from the mysteries of Ancient Egypt, and their profound relationship to the cosmos as expressed through the presence and alignment of their monumental architecture. events.name: Tough Old Bird, Ivy's Home
events.info: Tough Old Bird was formed by songwriting brothers Matthew and Nathan Corrigan in a rural corner of Western New York. Since releasing 'Gambling Days' in 2016, the band's lineup has expanded to feature Ricky Bechard on drums and Brendan O'Shea on bass. Tough Old Bird's latest album, 'Garden Dream' is the band's fullest and most collaborative effort to date. Born out of years of songwriting, the record finds the band layering new sounds while mining childhood memories and grown-up heartbreak to explore themes of moving on and moving forward---as children, and as adults. "The duo of Matthew and Nathan Corrigan draw influences from traditional folk music that maps out dusty and sepia-tinted landscapes with its songwriting, as well as the modern context of rust belt melancholia... They possess the inherent sadness of Iron & Wine's songwriting, the intricate guitar licks of Milk Carton Kids, and the persistent dancing banjo of the Avett Brothers." - Buffablog

events.name: House Party: A sweaty love-letter to the 2010s rager.
events.info: After Dark Presents House Party: A sweaty love-letter to the 2010s rager. Hey, welcome back to the 10s. Sticky red cup in hand. An ill-fitting pleather jacket or cardigan over a V-neck statement tee. Your friends are all here. And somehow, everyone is actually dancing. (What a concept.) The soundtrack is angsty, loud, and blown out; 2010s pop anthems, ripping bloghouse, hip-hop singalongs, golden-era EDM bangers, and the indie tracks you forgot you knew every word to. Tonight is all that matters. Put on your skinny jeans. Lace up your Converse. Turn the iPhone off. This is a love letter to the house parties of yesteryear, with the speakers cranked to 11, sticky floors, and absolutely no neighbors coming to shut it down. It's not nostalgia. It's muscle memory.
